summary: Asks Hosts to warn their users when the local IMP announces it is going down. BBN Report 1822 defines an IMP-to-Host message that says when the IMP will go down, for how long and why, but Hosts were not reliably passing that on to people using the network.

eli5.summary: When the power company says the lights will go off soon, you should tell everyone in the house. This note asks computers to warn their users the same way.

questions: what is the imp going down message
why warn users before an imp goes down
